changelog: **Affiliate partner funnel in the admin panel (#3544):** a new Funnel tab (`/admin/affiliates/funnel`, `GET /api/admin/affiliate/funnel`, `affiliate.read`) lists every partner's clicks, unique clicks, registrations, paying, active and passive customers, the two conversion rates and the customers left to the plan's switch, for this month / the last 12 months / all time, sorted and paged on the server through an allowlist (`id` tiebreak, unknown values 400). The numbers are the shared funnel the partner portal reads (`src/lib/affiliateFunnel.ts`, #3543); the admin-only warning badges — many clicks without a registration, mostly passive paying customers, commission windows ending within 30 days — come from the pure, unit-tested `src/lib/affiliateFunnelBoardRule.ts`. The overview shows the org total.

en: The affiliate programme has a new Funnel tab: clicks, registrations, paying, active and passive customers per partner, with warnings for partners that need a look. The overview shows the total for all partners.
tr: Affiliate programında yeni bir Huni sekmesi var: her partner için tıklama, kayıt, ödeme yapan, aktif ve pasif müşteri sayıları ile dikkat gerektiren partnerler için uyarılar. Genel bakışta tüm partnerlerin toplamı görünüyor.
de: Das Affiliate-Programm hat einen neuen Tab „Funnel“: Klicks, Registrierungen sowie zahlende, aktive und passive Kunden pro Partner, mit Hinweisen auf Partner, die einen Blick brauchen. Die Übersicht zeigt die Summe aller Partner.
